sources.title: SpectralGPT: Spectral Remote Sensing Foundation Model
sources.snippet: Customized foundation model for spectral data: SpectralGPT is the first purpose-built foundation model designed explicitly for spectral RS data. SpectralGPT considers unique characteristics of spectral data, i.e., spatial-spectral coupling and spectral sequentiality, in the MAE framework with a simple yet effective 3D GPT network.
